name: Phase Oscillator
author: Eric Gao
description: Casio CZ-style phase distortion. One phase ramp feeds a sine and a cosine reader, each with its own operator bending the ramp before it indexes the table. The waveform changes; the pitch does not.

controls.label: Depth
controls.description: How much of both bends is applied. Fully down bypasses them, leaving a plain sine and cosine.

controls.label: Bend
controls.description: Knee position on the sine path: the cycle's first part runs faster, the rest slower. The CZ saw.

controls.label: Plateau
controls.description: Width of a flat hold mid-cycle on the cosine path, which levels the wave. The CZ pulse.

controls.label: Blend
controls.description: Crossfades MAIN from the sine path to the cosine path.

outputs.main: Sine path crossfaded to cosine path by Blend
